name: Hitotsubashi Kanna
source:
Kanna is introduced as a girl that lives in the Kanzaki house, and has been good friends with Takahisa and Miyu since childhood.
Though she often comes off as a non-serious person that runs away from responsibility, Kanna will not hesitate to protect Takahisa and [url=/c3271]Miyu[/url].

[Edited from [url=http://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/]Yuumei's review[/url].]
